description: This file defines a static class 'JSInteropConstants' containing constant strings used for JavaScript interop calls within a Blazor application, specifically related to cookie management and UI behaviors.

classes.name: JSInteropConstants
classes.description: A static class containing string constants for JavaScript interop functions.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function to delete a cookie.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function to retrieve a cookie.

methods.name: RouteOutside
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function to route outside the application.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function to hide the body overflow, likely disabling scrolling.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Represents the JavaScript function to show the body overflow, likely enabling scrolling.
